items.problem: Copied UWP code using Windows.UI.Colors / Windows.UI.ColorHelper fails to build (CS0234) because the bootstrap only rewrites Windows.UI.Xaml.
items.evidence: session-log.txt MainPage.xaml.cs(80,67)/(83,67) 'error CS0234: ... Colors does not exist in the namespace Windows.UI'; lessons.json errors_encountered[0].
items.root_cause: Colors and ColorHelper moved from Windows.UI to Microsoft.UI in WinUI 3, but Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1's namespace mass-replace only handles Windows.UI.Xaml.
items.change: Extend the namespace rewrite loop in Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 to also replace the exact tokens 'Windows.UI.ColorHelper' -> 'Microsoft.UI.ColorHelper' and 'Windows.UI.Colors' -> 'Microsoft.UI.Colors', chosen so the Windows.UI.Color struct and non-moved Windows.UI.* namespaces (Core/Input/ViewManagement/Popups) are left untouched. Also add the ColorHelper row to the MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md Namespace Mapping table and update the intro sentence.
items.expected_effect: Apps using named colors / SolidColorBrush(Colors.X) build without a manual Colors fixup.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run, no CS0234 'Colors does not exist in the namespace Windows.UI' error; grep of the migrated tree finds 0 residual 'Windows.UI.Colors'/'Windows.UI.ColorHelper' while 'Windows.UI.Color ' struct usages remain intact.

items.problem: Root-namespace collision/mismatch: project namespace = app name shadows an identically-named WinRT type (CS0118) and desyncs from the copied UWP 'SDKTemplate' pages so 'App' is invisible (CS0103).
items.evidence: session-log.txt Scenario2_Polling.xaml.cs(22,17) CS0118 'Altimeter is a namespace but is used like a type'; MainPage/Scenario*.xaml.cs CS0103 'App does not exist'; UWP source 'namespace SDKTemplate' (L462) vs scaffold 'namespace Altimeter'; agent workaround 'using AltimeterSensor = ...' (L2859).
items.root_cause: WinUI scaffold sets root namespace to the app/project name; UWP SDK samples are named after a WinRT API and use 'namespace SDKTemplate'. Mixed namespaces + name/type collision produce the CS0118 + CS0103 cluster.
items.change: Add a 'CS0103 App / CS0118 namespace' build-error section to MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md: unify every file onto the UWP source's original root namespace (rename the few scaffold-generated files, not the many copied ones), and document the sensor/device-name vs WinRT-type collision with the `using AltimeterSensor = Windows.Devices.Sensors.Altimeter;` alias fallback.
items.expected_effect: Agent unifies namespaces up front, avoiding the CS0118/CS0103 cluster common to device/sensor samples.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run of a sensor-named sample, no CS0118 'is a namespace but is used like a type' and no CS0103 'App does not exist'; a single root namespace across App/MainWindow/pages.
items.tier_justification: Tier-1 auto-rename of the root namespace would be a broad, risky rewrite touching x:Class/xmlns across every file and could corrupt partial-class links; the collision is trivial to fix once flagged, so a targeted documented pattern is the highest-reliability low-risk fix.
